```{r setup}
library(readr)
library(fOptions)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r data-loading}
euro_chains <- read_csv("././Data_fetch/european_options_2026-01-26_greeks.csv")
usa_chains <- read_csv("././Data_fetch/american_options_2026-01-26_greeks.csv")

head(euro_chains)
head(usa_chains)
```

``` {r expirations}
origin_date <- as.Date("2026-01-26") 

# Calculate T for euro_chains (assuming there's an expiration column)
euro_chains$T <- as.numeric(as.Date(euro_chains$expiration) - origin_date) / 365
# Calculate T for usa_chains
usa_chains$T <- as.numeric(as.Date(usa_chains$expiration) - origin_date) / 365
```

``` {r data-filtering}
euro_call_chains <- euro_chains[euro_chains$option_type == "Call", ]
euro_put_chains <- euro_chains[euro_chains$option_type == "Put", ]

usa_condition <- usa_chains$ticker == "TSLA"

usa_call_chains <- usa_chains[usa_chains$option_type == "Call" & usa_condition, ]
usa_put_chains <- usa_chains[usa_chains$option_type == "Put" & usa_condition, ]
```

```{r european-bs}
# ============================================
# EUROPEAN BLACK-SCHOLES
# ============================================

# European Call Option
bs_european_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(d1) - K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(d2)
  return(price)
}

# European Put Option  
bs_european_put <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  d1 <- (log(S / K) + (r - q + sigma^2 / 2) * T) / (sigma * sqrt(T))
  d2 <- d1 - sigma * sqrt(T)
  
  price <- K * exp(-r * T) * pnorm(-d2) - S * exp(-q * T) * pnorm(-d1)
  return(price)
}
```

```{r american-bs-temp}
bs_american_call <- function(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0) {
  # TODO: Rozšířit o Barone-Adesi & Whaley aproximaci
  return(bs_european_call(S, K, r, sigma, T, q = 0))
}
```

``` {r population}
usa_call_chains <- usa_call_chains %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(user_bs = bs_american_call(S, K, r, sigma, T)) %>%
  mutate(user_crr = CRRBinomialTreeOption(TypeFlag = "ca", S = S, X = K, Time = T, r = r, b = r, sigma = sigma, n = 100)@price)
```

```{r validation-plot}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Reshape to long format for easier plotting
plot_data <- usa_call_chains %>%
  select(option_price, user_bs, user_crr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(user_bs, user_crr),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "calculated_price"
  )

# Scatter plot with 45-degree reference line
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = option_price, y = calculated_price, color = method)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  facet_wrap(~method) +
  labs(
    x = "Actual Market Price",
    y = "Calculated Price",
    title = "Model Prices vs Market Prices"
  ) +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r contour-plot}
# Prepare data for contour plot
contour_data <- usa_call_chains %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(moneyness = S / K) %>%
  select(moneyness, T, option_price, user_bs, user_crr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(user_bs, user_crr),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "calculated_price"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pricing_error = option_price - calculated_price)

# Contour plot: Moneyness (S/K) vs Time to Expiration (T)
# Contours show pricing error (actual - calculated)
#newplot()
ggplot(contour_data, aes(x = moneyness, y = T, z = pricing_error)) +
  geom_contour_filled(aes(fill = after_stat(level)), bins = 20) +
  facet_wrap(~method, nrow = 2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Pricing Error\n(Market - Model)") +
  labs(
    x = "Moneyness (S/K)",
    y = "Time to Expiration (T)",
    title = "Pricing Error Contour Plot - TSLA Call Options",
    subtitle = "Blue = Model overprices, Red = Model underprices"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
#saveplot()
```
